elichika is a private server for SIFAS (Love Live! School Idol Festival All Stars). This app runs the server, its WebUI, and the dev/modding tools on your phone — point the game at 127.0.0.1:8080.\n\nServer + dev tools by the elichika project (forks of YumeMichi / arina999999997 / tatara_hisoka). Modding tools: SIFAS-MODDING-HELPING-TOOLS.

This downloads the full game data set (several GB) from archive.org. Wi-Fi is strongly recommended. Pick a region:
This downloads missing game packs from the CDN (size varies, can be large). Wi-Fi is recommended.
The running server will be stopped first.

This restores the ORIGINAL (vanilla) game data and removes EVERY installed or cloned mod costume / live / card. It ALSO resets ALL accounts back to a new-account state.

Logins are kept, so the game client keeps working — it will just see a fresh server.

Kept: settings (config), downloaded game packs, and your files in Download/sukusta (mod zips, extracted/modded bundles, backups).

This CANNOT be undone. If you might want your data back, make a DB backup (Server content tab) and export your account (Account tab) first.
Really reset the server AND all accounts now? This CANNOT be undone.

1. Grant storage permission (for the shared Download/sukusta folder).
2. Tap “Start server”.
3. Point the game app at 127.0.0.1:8080 (see the LL-hax guide).
4. (Optional) Pre-download game files — “Download all game files” (full set, archive.org) or “Download missing” (CDN). Recommended, not required.

CDN cache: when on, missing packs download on demand while you play and are saved to packs/, so pre-downloading is optional. If you rely on it to fill packs/, keep elichika in the foreground (not the game) while it downloads so they finish.

Tabs: “Server” / “Account” = server web UI · “Server content” = dev tools · “Asset editing” = modding tools.

Folders (Download/sukusta): extracted = decrypted models (edit input) · modded = edited bundles (edit output) · suit / live / card / livetimeline = add-on drop folders · sql = DB patches · packs = game pack cache · backup = DB backups · logs = elichika.log.
